Explore Features

Feature Highlights

Dual permanently synchronous electric motors (360 kW total)

<p>The GLC 400 4MATIC's dual electric motors total 360 kW output. They can distribute up to 483 hp and 590 lb-ft of torque to all four wheels with exceptional efficiency and smoothness. The rear "permanently excited synchronous motor" (PSM) employs magnets that use nearly no rare earth elements. The front PSM activates based on power or traction needs.</p>

DC fast charging up to 800V

<p>DC fast charging lets you charge the battery at up to 330kW at stations supporting up to 800V technology. In just 22 minutes, it can bring the battery from just 10 percent charged to 80 percent. At a 400V station, up to 100kW charging is possible.</p>

Charging times are estimated and may vary by location, equipment and other conditions. Charging stations must be compatible with J1772-type (AC) or NACS-type (DC) charging connectors. An adapter may be required for Combined Charging System (CCS1) connectors. See your dealer for more information.

20-inch honeycomb wheels w/black accents

<p>Sizable 20-inch wheels feature a cellular visual structure with machine-finished edges set against contrasting gloss black inlays. The lightweight alloy wheels are staggered in width and fitted with Extended Mobility all-season tires.</p>

Lower-aspect-ratio tires and accompanying wheels may provide substantially increased treadwear, increased tire noise and reduced ride comfort. Serious wheel and tire damage may occur if the vehicle is operated on rough or damaged road surfaces or upon encountering road debris or obstacles. These tires are not designed for use on snow and ice. Winter tires mounted on appropriately sized and approved wheels are recommended for driving in those conditions.

Models equipped with Extended Mobility tires are not provided with a spare wheel.

4th Generation Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX)

<p>The fourth generation of the Mercedes-Benz User Experience (MBUX) offers a highly personalized cabin experience. Artificial Intelligence from Microsoft and Google is integrated into the displays, touch-sensitive controls, and voice assistant, to help create a system that responds more naturally, seamlessly and rapidly to the needs, desires and commands of the driver and passengers.</p>

Digital Extra: MBUX Navigation with Electric Intelligence (7 years)

<p>MBUX Navigation offers intuitive operation via touch or the lifelike MBUX Virtual Assistant. Electric Intelligence helps optimize your route options, dynamically factoring traffic, topography and temperature, as well as charging needs and options. Active Range Monitoring can further help you maximize range along the way with useful information and suggestions. Seven years of services are standard.</p>

While the navigation system provides directional assistance, the driver must remain focused on safe driving behavior, including paying attention to traffic and street signs. Maps do not cover all areas or all routes within an area, may require periodic updating, and may not reflect recent or temporary changes to roadways.

Requires an active Mercedes me account, available at no charge. See Operator's Manual for additional information.

Feature is offered as a Digital Extra. A personal Mercedes me ID, agreement to the Terms of Use for Mercedes-Benz Digital Extras, and pairing of the vehicle and user account are required to activate the feature in the vehicle. Upon expiration of the initial term, most features can be renewed for a fee, provided they are still offered for the vehicle.

Sound Personalization

<p>In addition to the Burmester® Surround Sound system's preset listening modes, Sound Personalization can tailor a variety of audio settings to suit your individual tastes and even focus the listening experience on specific seats.</p>

Burmester is a registered trademark of Burmester Audiosysteme GmbH, Berlin, Germany.
